braid_class_representatives — DRIVE braidpath op

• Data kinds: any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.braid_class_representatives(plans, obstacles=None, costs=None, angle=0.1, jitter='auto') (to call the implementation directly, import braidpath; braidpath.braid_class_representatives(plans, obstacles=None, costs=None, angle=0.1, jitter='auto'); from the registry, opsdrive.get("braid_class_representatives"))

Usage

Partitions several plans (output of any planner) into homotopy classes and picks the lowest-cost plan in each class as its representative.

A plan is a (K, T, 2) trajectory, a sequence of grid paths, or a planner dict (paths; failed None entries are skipped and counted). All plans must share the same start and end points (the class is the class of deformations with fixed endpoints). The cost is costs or, if absent, the sum of the trajectory lengths.

Returns: dict classes (list in increasing order of cost; each element is a dict: key, word (representative word), best (plan index), cost, count, members), n_plans, n_failed, n_classes.
